name: scholialang
description: Preserve reasoning state across long-horizon work in Codex: local per-project auto-emit tracing and reference tools.

interface.longDescription: Scholia helps agentic systems preserve reasoning state, use tools without quality loss, and reduce context cost across long-horizon work. This plugin adds local MCP tools for project-aware trace capture, compact summaries, search, export, and reference lookup. It stores traces on your machine and helps Codex retrieve small summaries instead of repeatedly carrying full work history in context.
defaultPrompt: Start a Scholialang trace for this project.
Search my Scholialang traces for decisions.
